response.sql: WITH per_patient AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(e.`aCL IgG`) AS igg, AVG(e.ANA) AS ana FROM Patient p JOIN Examination e ON e.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), per_sex AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(igg) AS avg_acl_igg, AVG(ana) AS avg_ana FROM per_patient GROUP BY SEX) SELECT SEX, avg_acl_igg, avg_ana, avg_ana / (SELECT AVG(avg_ana) FROM per_sex) AS ana_ratio FROM per_sex

assumptions.assumption: The denominator is the unweighted mean of the per-sex average ANA values, taken over every sex group returned, including a NULL or blank SEX group if one exists. Sex groups whose average ANA is NULL are ignored by that mean.
Patients with a NULL SEX value are kept as their own group.
